entries.columnsContract: `acceptance_decision_id PK, acceptance_attempt_id FK, result(accepted|rejected), offer_id, on_deck_package_id, package_digest, related_disposition_set_digest, shelf_id FK, standard_revision, placement_revision, acceptance_evidence_set_digest, rejection_schema_ref NULL, rejection_code NULL, rejection_digest NULL, decision_digest, decided_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `acceptance_decision_id=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"arca.acceptance-decision-id@1",acceptanceAttemptId}))`且`UNIQUE(acceptance_attempt_id)`；Offer/Package/Related disposition set逐字节等于Attempt；accepted要求rejection列全NULL且证明完整处置义务可履行；rejected固定`rejection_schema_ref=StructuredRejection@1`且code/digest非NULL，并逐项重建`ArcaAcceptanceRejectionDecision@1`；immutable

entries.columnsContract: `custody_id PK, acceptance_decision_id FK, on_deck_package_id, package_digest, control_scope_digest, related_disposition_set_digest, state, accepted_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(on_deck_package_id,package_digest)`；只有Accepted Decision可建立；`control_scope_digest`只覆盖正式Product Control transfer，`related_disposition_set_digest`逐字节冻结Package中全部exclusive Related的source-to-final义务，两者不得合并为一个Control Scope

entries.columnsContract: `receipt_id PK, acceptance_decision_id FK, outcome(accepted|rejected), offer_id, custody_id NULL, on_deck_package_id, package_digest, arca_binding_set_digest NULL, control_revision_set_digest NULL, related_disposition_set_digest, rejection_code NULL, acceptance_evidence_set_digest, rejection_digest NULL, receipt_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(acceptance_decision_id)`及`UNIQUE(offer_id)`；Offer/Package/Related disposition set逐字节等于Decision；accepted要求Custody/Binding/Control列非NULL、全部rejection列为NULL，receipt digest按`CustodyAndTransferReceipt@1`公式重建，其中Related set不进入Control digest；rejected要求Custody/Binding/Control列NULL且rejection列非NULL，receipt digest按`RejectionReceipt@1`公式重建；两种终态都必须有receipt digest并作为各自typed Outbox的durable source，相同marker不新增Receipt或相反终态

entries.columnsContract: `owner_object_type, owner_object_id, material_key, role, authority_kind(product_control|related_derived), primary_material_key NULL, source_related_reference_id NULL, derived_authority_digest NULL, episode_claims_schema_ref, episode_claims_json, episode_claim_set_digest, endpoint_id, location, mount_scope_id, inode, size_bytes, fingerprint_algorithm, fingerprint_version, content_fingerprint, binding_revision, health_state, evidence_digest, current`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(owner_object_type,owner_object_id,material_key,role,binding_revision)`；每个物理Material/role/revision只有一row且每个关系只有一个current row。每行冻结可重建`material_key`的完整Physical Material Identity tuple，Aftercare或历史重放不得用当前Shelf mount scope猜测旧Identity。`product_control`逐项命中Handoff B Product member及Control transfer，三个Related authority列全NULL；`related_derived`只用于Off-load Context中仍为原Physical Identity的exclusive Related，必须命中同Package source reference、Primary及derived authority且不声明独立Control。两种variant严格互斥。Episode JSON固定`helix://contracts/application-types/ArcaMaterialEpisodeClaims/v1`、canonical JCS≤`16 KiB`，schema/json/digest均非NULL并逐字节满足8.6.19公式；Series Primary为`1..32`项，single Primary及非Primary/Off-load Context-only Binding为空Set；`evidence_digest`与`arcaBindingSetDigest`覆盖完整typed Set、Physical Identity和authority variant，禁止只取第一项、复制member row或旁读Libra补值

entries.columnsContract: `on_deck_run_id PK, custody_id FK, final_inventory_decision_digest, state(ready|offloading|blocked|committed), created_at_ms, terminal_at_ms, target_reserved_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: 只允许Handoff B Accepted transaction与immutable Final Inventory Decision同事务首次建立；同一Custody一个non-terminal Run；`blocked`在自动预算未耗尽时可恢复，耗尽后是零资源且投影为`attention_required`的稳定业务暂停态，只有显式用户Retry可把同一Run恢复为`offloading`；只有`committed`为terminal且写`terminal_at_ms`；`target_reserved_at_ms`只在Arca同事务重验Final Decision目标无其他未Commit持有者后、首次进入offloading时写入，blocked保留；未取得预约的blocked不得阻塞其他Run，恢复须重新竞争；committed后预约失效但保留历史时间；Supporting Work通过Foundation反向关联；`INDEX(state,created_at_ms)`

entries.columnsContract: `final_inventory_decision_id PK, on_deck_run_id FK, shelf_id FK, placement_revision, target_endpoint_id, target_location, product_manifest_digest, offload_context_digest, related_disposition_set_digest, decision_schema_ref, decision_json, decision_digest, decided_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: Decision JSON上限`8 MiB`（最多1024成员，完整映射及摘要保留；Foundation Result仍为64 KiB）；`UNIQUE(on_deck_run_id)`；immutable；必须逐项覆盖Package Product member及全部Related source-to-final mapping，不允许active Shelf Entry依赖Field中的exclusive Related；不保存adopt/replace/relocate动作类型

entries.columnsContract: `authorization_id, revision, state(enabled|revoked), authorization_scope_kind(old_primary_input|exclusive_related_input|old_primary_and_exclusive_related), actor_id, authorization_digest, effective_at_ms, revoked_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(authorization_id,revision)`；immutable；只授权为精确On-deck Scope派生Approval，不授权目录范围。Authorization revision必须显式覆盖`exclusive_related_input`才可派生该类Approval；合同修订前或scope-kind不含该值的旧revision不得静默扩大
singleton key固定；current pair显式FK；启用/撤销均发布新revision，不物理删除历史

entries.columnsContract: `approval_id PK, on_deck_run_id FK, settlement_scope_digest, settlement_member_set_digest, source_to_final_mapping_digest, final_product_verification_digest, standing_authorization_id, standing_authorization_revision, actor_or_policy_ref, approved_at_ms, state`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(on_deck_run_id,settlement_scope_digest)`；每项member必须分类为`old_primary_input|structural_dependency|exclusive_related_input`并命中同Run Off-load Context、source-to-final mapping及已通过的Final Product Verification；自动模式只可由当前且显式覆盖全部scope class的standing authorization派生，已签发Scope不可扩张，目录、未来材料、ambiguous/shared Related和未映射成员不得进入

entries.columnsContract: `shelf_entry_id PK, shelf_id FK, structure_kind, status, canonical_identity_revision, canonical_identity_key, current_inventory_revision, current_deck_fact_revision, created_at_ms, terminal_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: 三个current pointer均显式FK；`INDEX(shelf_id,status,shelf_entry_id)`；Movie/JAV/Western可以重复，Season对active `(shelf_id,canonical_identity_key)`建立partial unique，保证后续Episode Run扩充同一Entry

`shelf_entry_id FK, inventory_revision, ordinal, material_key, role(primary_payload|structural_dependency|metadata_sidecar|poster|fanart|subtitle|external_audio|chapter|sidecar), episode_claims_schema_ref, episode_claims_json, episode_claim_set_digest, endpoint_id, location, binding_revision, mount_scope_id, inode, fingerprint_algorithm, fingerprint_version, content_fingerprint, digest_hex, size_bytes, artifact_scope_schema_ref NULL, artifact_scope_json NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(shelf_entry_id,inventory_revision,ordinal)`；每个物理Material在一版Inventory中只有一row，active representation中Primary Material全局exclusive partial unique；每row必须逐字保存完整`PhysicalMaterialIdentity@2` tuple，且`material_key`必须等于该tuple的canonical digest，使文件已经missing时Aftercare仍能签发精确Control release。最终物化的Related/Artifact与Primary一样必须作为Target-contained Inventory Material row，不能只保留外部Reference。Episode JSON固定`helix://contracts/application-types/ArcaMaterialEpisodeClaims/v1`、canonical JCS≤`16 KiB`且三列均非NULL，由同一On-deck Run verified `StagedInventoryManifest@1` member逐字节复制；Inventory Representation与Deck Fact digest覆盖完整typed Set，历史revision从本row独立重建，不得复制多条Material row表达多个Episode；`artifact_scope_json`仅Series NFO保存Arca内部`helix://arca/inventory-artifact-scope/v1` closed JCS（≤4 KiB）：schemaVersion=1、artifactKind=nfo、seasonNumber、episodeScope（整季为NULL）、requirementDigest、sourcePackageId、sourceArtifactHandleId、sourceArtifactReferenceDigest与scopeDigest。其scopeDigest覆盖除自身外完整值，Requirement由冻结Episode scope重建；On-deck从Accepted Artifact与verified Staged成员关联生成，随Inventory/Deck摘要和原子事务提交，追加/维修revision逐字保留未变目标。其他角色/非Series为NULL，不得用NFO Episode Claim或文件名猜测替代此关系
